title: every box that runs the tester allows unprivileged user namespaces
intention: Every Linux box that runs cairn's tester persists kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0 in /etc/sysctl.d/60-uu-userns.conf, so bwrap builds the tester's instance seal and `cairn test --exec` runs instead of refusing.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: after its reinstall, akienasus read the key as 1, so `cairn test --exec` refused and the codemother proofs that re-run an instrument under the seal read red here and green on akiendelllinux. The Dell's UU-era /etc/sysctl.d/60-uu-userns.conf was the only record of the setting, and nothing installs it.
traces_to: Law 8 (the seal a hollow build cannot pass needs this host setting) and the host-seam class: the intentions folder is the seed a bare box regrows from.
how: The host-seam intention carries an apply block (tee the sysctl.d file, sysctl -p, install bubblewrap) and a verify command (the live key is 0, the file holds the line, and `bin/cairn test --exec true --timeout 30` exits 0). Applied on akienasus 2026-11-12; prove by running the verify on each box.

clauses.claim: the intention's verify command exits 0 on akienasus
the intention's verify command exits 0 on akiendelllinux

decisions.text: D1: the host-seam intention, with its apply, verify, horizon and the cost of lifting the restriction, berths in intentions-not-beside-code.

out: cairn/devices/tester (its refusal text already names the live fix; not changed)

measured.saw: akienasus: the key read 1; /etc/sysctl.d held only 99-zram.conf and README.sysctl; `cairn test --exec` refused for want of bwrap's sandbox
akienasus after apply: verify exit 0, test_deposit green
measured.how: the intention's verify command; bin/cairn test cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_deposit.py
